changeSet.author: app
changeSet.comment: Nomeia PKs e FK da auditoria global sem recriar constraints nem alterar o histórico publicado.
changeSet.sql: DO $rename$ DECLARE constraint_name RECORD; actual_constraint RECORD; BEGIN FOR constraint_name IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('audit_operation', 'audit_operation_pkey', 'pk_audit_operation', 'p', 'id_audit_operation', NULL, NULL), ('audit_change', 'audit_change_pkey', 'pk_audit_change', 'p', 'id_audit_change', NULL, NULL), ('audit_change', 'audit_change_id_audit_operation_fkey', 'fk_audit_change_operation', 'f', 'id_audit_operation', 'audit_operation', 'id_audit_operation') ) AS names(table_name, old_name, new_name, expected_type, column_name, referenced_table, referenced_column) LOOP -- Validate either name before accepting an already renamed constraint. FOR actual_constraint IN SELECT c.* FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'auditoria' AND t.relname = constraint_name.table_name AND c.conname IN (constraint_name.old_name, constraint_name.new_name) LOOP IF actual_constraint.contype::text IS DISTINCT FROM constraint_name.expected_type OR actual_constraint.conkey IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY( SELECT a.attnum FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = actual_constraint.conrelid AND a.attname = constraint_name.column_name AND NOT a.attisdropped ) OR (constraint_name.expected_type = 'f' AND ( actual_constraint.confrelid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass(format('%I.%I', 'auditoria', constraint_name.referenced_table))::oid OR actual_constraint.confkey IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY( SELECT a.attnum FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = to_regclass( format('%I.%I', 'auditoria', constraint_name.referenced_table)) AND a.attname = constraint_name.referenced_column AND NOT a.attisdropped ) )) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid constraint definition for % on %.%: expected type %, column %, reference %.%(%)', actual_constraint.conname, 'auditoria', constraint_name.table_name, constraint_name.expected_type, constraint_name.column_name, 'auditoria', constraint_name.referenced_table, constraint_name.referenced_column; END IF; END LOOP; IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'auditoria' AND t.relname = constraint_name.table_name AND c.conname = constraint_name.old_name ) THEN EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I.%I RENAME CONSTRAINT %I TO %I', 'auditoria', constraint_name.table_name, constraint_name.old_name, constraint_name.new_name); ELSIF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'auditoria' AND t.relname = constraint_name.table_name AND c.conname = constraint_name.new_name ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected constraint % or % on %.%', constraint_name.old_name, constraint_name.new_name, 'auditoria', constraint_name.table_name; END IF; END LOOP; END; $rename$;
